plan.title: RFQ mandatory terms require all clauses

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required event title so publishing can proceed.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite the available QA vendor used for the vendor-side verification.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Continue in the separate supplier portal session.
Open the Technical stage as the invited vendor.
The RFQ-only clause must not appear on the Technical stage.
The second RFQ-only clause must not appear on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the mandatory clauses apply.
Verify the first RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept exactly one of the two mandatory clauses.
Leave the second mandatory clause unaccepted.
Attempt submission after accepting only one clause; the vendor must be blocked until both mandatory clauses are accepted.
